name: Reconciliation Repair Contract

repairCategories.INVALIDATE_DERIVED: 失效派生项 (canonical 已删除)
repairCategories.RELEASE_STALE_LEASE: 释放过期租赁 (通过 Domain Owner API)
repairCategories.RETRY_CANONICAL_OUTBOX: 重试 Canonical Outbox (通过 Outbox Owner API)
repairCategories.REQUEST_CANONICAL_REPAIR: 请求 Domain Owner 修复 (人工或 Owner 处理)

currentImplementation.actualExecution: 当前实现仅标记 RepairAction，不自动执行。修复通过已有系统 (DataLifecycle Executor) 间接完成。
currentImplementation.dataLifecyclePath: TombstoneDerivedData → DataLifecycle Coordinator 自动处理 cleanup + recalculation

principles: Authority Directed: 所有修复通过 Canonical Domain Owner API
Idempotent: 重复执行不产生额外副作用
Auditable: 所有 RepairAction 记录在 ReconciliationDiff 中
Re-verifiable: 修复后重新 Read Authority 确认 diff 消失
